_note: Tuning for goal.py (task-goal) and check.py (task-contract). Start conservative and tune against real goals and diffs. Thresholds are tuned against `model`; re-tune when it changes. Never carry a threshold across primitives: a Noul value and a Choice confidence are not comparable. Changing this file mid-task stops the task until the user runs check.py --accept-config.

goal_clarity._note: Whole-goal check at --check, --record and --revise. Scores are out of 3.0.

objective_clarity._note: One Jev request per objective and per rule. Each Noul asks about a defect; at or above its value blocks the goal.

scope._note: Checked per changed file on every step. outside_scope at or above block_verdict_confidence blocks; any drift Noul at or above drift_block blocks; a verdict below min_verdict_confidence escalates to the user.

completion._note: Checked per objective against only its files. An objective is met at or above item_complete.

diff._note: Unchanged lines around each change. Completion first tries whole enclosing functions, then falls back to completion_fallback_lines.

verify._note: Seconds before a Verify command, or its Requires check, counts as couldn't run.

request_budget._note: Jev allows 32k tokens for state plus the longest question per request. Code tokenizes denser than prose, so estimate low and keep headroom.

handoff._note: Context usage at which the agent hands off to a new session, used only when reliable usage information is available.
